feeds.title: Associated General Contractors of America News
feeds.description: For more than 100 years the Associated General Contractors of America (AGC) has been and still is the leading association for the construction industry. We are the oldest and largest construction association representing general and specialty contractors and represent more than 27,000 firms, including over 6,500 of America's leading general contractors, over 8,800 specialty-contracting firms, and more than 10,400 service providers and suppliers.

feeds.title: Zieba Builders Blog

feeds.title: AZAGC News
feeds.description: The Arizona Chapter, Associated General Contractors (AZAGC), chartered in 1934, is a not-for-profit association of general contractors, subcontractors, and other construction industry affiliated firms engaged in highway, heavy, industrial and municipal-utility construction.

feeds.title: AH Construction Blog

feeds.title: General Contractors Magazine
